name: narrow_range_breakout_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus
thesis: NR4/NR7 patterns (today's daily range is the narrowest of the last 4 or 7 days) signal volatility compression that precedes range expansion. On such days, the intraday breakout from the first-hour range tends to be more decisive because compressed volatility acts like a coiled spring. The edge exists because NR days are identifiable before the market opens (based on prior days' ranges), allowing pre-session preparation. The inefficiency persists because NR days occur only ~15-20% of the time, and many traders do not systematically track multi-day range compression. When the breakout occurs on an NR day, it has higher follow-through because the prior compression absorbed conflicting orders, and the breakout resolves the ambiguity.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > 40 crore INR AND is_NR4_or_NR7_day == True

indicators.name: is_NR4
indicators.params: True if today's daily range < min(daily_range[-1], ..., daily_range[-3])

indicators.name: is_NR7
indicators.params: True if today's daily range < min(daily_range[-1], ..., daily_range[-6])

conditions: is_NR4 == True OR is_NR7 == True (pre-session filter)
long.confirmation: breakout bar closes within top 30% of its range AND next bar also closes above first_hour_high

short.confirmation: breakout bar closes within bottom 30% of its range AND next bar also closes below first_hour_low

entry.entry_price: market order on confirmation (2nd bar closing beyond first-hour range)

exit.target: 1.5 * ATR(14d) from entry (NR days tend to expand by 1-2 ATR)
exit.trailing_stop: trail at 0.5 * ATR(14d) once profit > 1.0 * ATR(14d)
exit.signal_exit: exit if price closes back inside first-hour range for 3 consecutive bars

risk.position_sizing: fixed 1L; increase to 1.5L on NR7 days (stronger signal than NR4)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22; NR days in high-VIX regimes are contradictory signals
filters.time_filter: entry only after 10:15 IST (first hour range must be established); no entries after 13:00
filters.trend_filter: prefer breakout direction aligned with NIFTY 50 trend of the day
filters.event_filter: NR days before RBI/budget are powerful — range expansion on event day is expected
other_filters: NR7 is preferred over NR4 for higher conviction; NR4-only trades get reduced position size

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — NR pattern tracking requires multi-day context; not commonly automated

weaknesses: NR days occur only 15-20% of the time — very low trade frequency (1-4 trades per week across universe)
Not all NR days result in range expansion on the same day — expansion may come the next day (useless for intraday)
The first-hour range on NR days can be very tight, making the breakout target small and stop tight — higher chance of noise-triggered exits
prior_art: NR4/NR7 patterns from Toby Crabel ('Day Trading with Short-Term Price Patterns', 1990). Extensively studied by Linda Raschke and Larry Connors ('Street Smarts'). Volatility compression preceding expansion is a well-established market principle. Indian adaptation combining NR with first-hour range breakout is less common.
notes: Edge math: 0.52 * 80bps - 0.48 * 44bps = 41.6 - 21.1 = 20.5 bps gross. Costs ~11 bps. Net ≈ 9.5 bps per trade. One of the strongest expected edges. Low trade frequency is the main challenge — need to scan the full NIFTY 200 universe daily to find stocks in NR4/NR7 patterns. Expect 2-5 qualifying stocks per NR day.
